describe: The repo requires AI-use disclosure, and the description has none.

ops.in: The repo's commit and PR rules
ops.regex: (?s)Recent history uses concise imperative commits.*?(?=\n\nBefore pushing)
ops.with: Recent history uses concise imperative commits. Keep commits and PRs focused on the requested change. Pull requests must disclose any AI assistance: name the tool and say how it was used, in the PR description.
